observations: Public dedupe+log_script plans removal of one unequal same-size file when supplied a synthetic equal report hash and default API config. Both file contents verified unchanged; no generated commands executed. CLI normally supplies report timestamp, so this control is scoped to public API default trust boundary.
Partition checks regular-file status, size and optional modification cutoff, but does not rehash or byte-compare before producing commands.

FsCommand execute assigns maybe_lock result to underscore; returned guard is not retained through the following operation. Move additionally discards lock acquisition error. Source inference, no concurrent lock counterexample.
Move checks target existence before an overwriting rename/copy; this is not atomic no-clobber. Source only.
safe_remove uses a random path without exclusive creation; rollback/cleanup failures log warnings. Source only.
run_script logs individual failures and continues; output contains successes rather than an all-or-nothing transaction.
log_script uses unbounded channel and reorder queue; no hard memory bound established.
scope: Full1633-line source read. Twenty original upstream tests executed only in new isolated temporary fixture working directory. One public dry-plan counterexample, no generated operation execution. No user source files modified, implementation adopted, physical concurrency/Windows/full42tree/full500/resource-cap qualification.
